verdict.rationale: Meta publishes a model card and use policy for every released Llama weight family. Downloads are gated behind accepting an acceptable use policy, and Meta ships first-party safeguard models (Llama Guard 3, aligned to the MLCommons hazards taxonomy, and Prompt Guard). Together these form a documented responsible-release process, but the pack never shows the safety evaluations, red-teaming results or risk assessments themselves. missing for 10: published red-teaming results, documented risk assessments or a frontier safety framework with release thresholds, evidence of the safety-evaluation contents of the model cards, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, the vendor publishes safety evaluations or a responsible-release process for its frontier models — red-teaming, risk assessments, or a safety framework with teeth

citations.quote: a published model card and use policy for every released weight family
